bundle.shortDescription: Keyboard-first control plane for Git worktrees and CLI coding agents
bundle.longDescription: Git Forest indexes your Git repositories, creates and safely removes worktrees, opens them in your terminal, and launches and tracks CLI coding agents such as Codex, Claude Code, and OpenCode.
